test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: How many years will it take for a certain sum to get doubled at the rate of 6{1over4}\% simple interest per annum?
solution:
Formula used :

SI = ( PRT / 100) 

P = Principal , R = Rate , T = Time

Calculation :

Assume principal = P

According to the question Amount = 2P

Rate = 6{1over4}\%

Time = T
